name: Arena FPS
core_loop: Hold a sight line and read the arena
Trade shots with a bot and break line of sight
Rotate to the ammo or health pickup
Push the frag count toward the match target

questions.question: How many bots should fill the arena?
How many weapons should the first build carry?

acceptance.promise: A shot down the crosshair takes exactly the authored damage off the target.
setup: Place one stationary bot at a fixed distance in the arena
Fill the player magazine to ammo_capacity
probes: Fire one shot aimed at the bot centre and read its health
Fire one shot deliberately wide and read its health
Fire until the magazine empties and read the ammo counter
evidence: The centred shot removes exactly damage health
The ammo counter reaches zero after ammo_capacity shots and refuses to fire

acceptance.promise: The match ends the moment a player reaches the frag target.
setup: Set score_target to a small value
probes: Kill bots one at a time and read the HUD frag tally
Read the match state on the kill that reaches score_target
evidence: The frag tally rises by one per kill
The match reports finished exactly on the target kill
No respawn or further scoring happens after the match ends
